pandas.DataFrame.sort_values

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Order items by one or more data values, controlling missing-value placement.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

Call syntax

DataFrame.sort_values(…) Full signature
DataFrame.sort_values(
    by,
    *,
    axis=0,
    ascending=True,
    inplace=…,
    kind='quicksort',
    na_position='last',
    ignore_index=False,
    key=None,
)

Parameters
ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
by
      Required
Positional or keyword		
      str or list of str
Supply one or more column labels for a row sort, or row labels for a column sort.


axis
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 0		
      "{0 or 'index', 1 or 'columns'}"
Choose which axis the operation acts on. The accepted axis labels depend on the receiver.


ascending
      Optional
Keyword only
Default True		
      bool or list of bool
Choose ascending or descending order. Some sorting methods take one flag per sort key.


inplace
      Optional
Keyword only		
      bool
Choose whether to change the existing object. Where supported, an in-place call typically returns None.


kind
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 'quicksort'		
      {'quicksort', 'mergesort', 'heapsort', 'stable'}
Choose the implementation variant, such as a sort algorithm or a plot type.


na_position
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 'last'		
      {'first', 'last'}
Place missing values first or last in the result.


ignore_index
      Optional
Keyword only
Default False		
      bool
Give the resulting axis new integer labels where supported.


key
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      callable
Supply a vectorized function that takes a Series and returns a same-shape Series used for sorting.

    
Returns
DataFrame or None
